AgentRunConfig.description:
Optional per-role or per-company overrides for agent loop resource limits.

Values are applied in precedence order:  {@link  LcpRole.runConfig  }  →  {@link  LcpCompany.runConfig  }  → environment variables → code defaults. Any field left undefined falls through to the next level.

maxIterations.description: Maximum number of LLM invocations before the run is cancelled as failed.

timeoutMs.description: Wall-clock timeout in milliseconds before the run is cancelled as failed.

AgentStatus.description: Lifecycle states for an agent instance.

AuditEvent.description: A single entry in the audit log for an agent run. Rows are written by lcp-agent as it processes LangGraph events. The composite index on `(companyId, agentId, timestamp)` supports efficient time-ordered queries and live-stream reads per ADR-008.

agent.description: The agent that produced this event. Nullable for system-level events.

agentId.description: Foreign key for the  {@link  LcpAgent }  that produced this event.

company.description: The company context for this event.

companyId.description: Foreign key for the owning  {@link  LcpCompany } .

payload.description:
Structured event payload. Content varies by  {@link  AuditEventType } :
- `llm_request` / `llm_response`: message content and token counts
- `tool_call` / `tool_result`: tool name, input, and output
- `decision`: summary and justification
- `state_change`: reason and new status

role.description: The role name at the time of the event (denormalised for query convenience since the role may be updated after the run).

timestamp.description: When this event was recorded. Defaults to the current time.

AuditEventType.description: Categories of event captured in the audit log (per ADR-008).

CompanyUser.description: A human user associated with a company. Used for query routing (matching conversations to the right user) and for the human-in-the-loop pause/resume flow in Phases 5–6.

companyId.description: The company this user belongs to.

createdAt.description: When this user was added to the company.

identifier.description: OIDC subject (`sub`) claim or email address — unique per company.

knowledgeDomains.description: Knowledge domains this user covers (e.g. `"finance"`, `"legal"`). Used by query routing to prefer the best-matched user.

memberType.description: Membership tier. `creator` is set on company creation and cannot be removed.

roles.description: Role slugs this user is responsible for. Used by query routing to match incoming agent questions to the right user.

ConsultationStatus.description: Lifecycle states for an inter-agent consultation.

Conversation.description:
A question posed by an agent to one or more human users. Created when an agent calls `request_user_input`; closed when a human replies.

The slug is human-readable (`{roleName}-{queryIndex}`) and is the primary identifier used by CLI commands. It is unique per role.

agentId.description: The agent that raised this question.

companyId.description: The company this conversation belongs to.

context.description: Optional additional context provided by the agent alongside the question.

question.description: The question the agent is asking.

roleId.description: The role ID that originated this question.

roleName.description: The role that originated this question (denormalised — kept even if role is later renamed).

routedToIdentifiers.description: OIDC identifiers of the users this question was routed to.

slug.description: Human-readable unique identifier in the form `{role-name}-{queryIndex}`.

ConversationMessage.description: A single message in a  {@link  Conversation  }  thread. Messages are append-only — one `agent` message (the question) followed by zero or one `user` message (the reply that closes the conversation).

author.description: Whether this message was written by the agent or a human user.

authorIdentifier.description: OIDC identifier of the user who replied (null for agent messages).

conversationId.description: The conversation this message belongs to.

EpisodicMemory.description: A single agent-authored memory entry stored for later recall. The embedding vector is stored in a `vector(1536)` column managed via raw SQL (pgvector extension) — not mapped by TypeORM.

agentId.description: The agent that recorded this memory (nullable — may be system-generated).

companyId.description: The company that owns this memory.

content.description: Raw text content of the memory.

roleId.description: The role whose episodic memory this belongs to.

KnowledgeChunk.description:
A single chunk of text extracted from an OKF knowledge-base document and stored for RAG retrieval. The corresponding embedding vector is stored directly in PostgreSQL as a `vector(1536)` column (pgvector extension) and is not mapped by TypeORM — all vector reads and writes use raw SQL.

Chunks are scoped to a  {@link  LcpRole  }  within a  {@link  LcpCompany  } . All chunks for a given `documentPath` are replaced atomically on re-index.

chunkIndex.description: Zero-based position of this chunk within its source document.

companyId.description: The company that owns this chunk.

content.description: Raw text content of this chunk.

documentPath.description: MinIO path of the OKF source document this chunk was extracted from. Used to identify all chunks belonging to one document for deletion/re-index.

roleId.description: The role whose knowledge base this chunk belongs to.

LcpAgent.description: A running instance of an  {@link  LcpRole }  within an  {@link  LcpCompany } . Each agent has a LangGraph `thread_id` (stored as  {@link  LcpAgent.threadId } ) that links it to its checkpoint in the PostgreSQL checkpoint store, enabling resumability.

company.description: The company this agent belongs to.

companyId.description: Foreign key for the owning  {@link  LcpCompany } .

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this agent record was created.

id.description: Auto-generated primary key. Also used as the LangGraph `thread_id`.

initialPrompt.description: The task prompt supplied when the agent was started.

output.description: Final output produced by the agent on completion. Set via the `complete_task` MCP tool, or as a fallback from the last AI message when the loop exits naturally.

pausedAt.description: Set when this agent transitions to  {@link  AgentStatus.Paused } ; cleared on resume. Scopes which consultation/conversation responses belong to the current pause episode when aggregating a resume message.

role.description: The role template this agent runs as.

roleId.description: Foreign key for the  {@link  LcpRole }  this agent is an instance of.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of this agent.

storageChanges.description:
Storage changes accumulated by the agent loop during the current (or last) run. Updated incrementally by lcp-agent as storage MCP tool calls complete. Used by lcp-mcp-interactions to include context in `complete_task` error messages.

Uses `simple-json` (stored as TEXT) for cross-DB compatibility with SQLite unit tests.

threadId.description: LangGraph checkpoint thread_id. Set to the agent's own UUID on first run. Null until the first BullMQ job is dispatched.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last status or field update.

LcpCompany.description: Represents a company (tenant) within the LCP simulation. Each company has its own isolated set of agents, memory, and resources.

companyContext.description:
Optional company context injected as prompt part 2 at agent start. Describes the company environment: agent roster, shared storage layout, company name and description, and any company-wide behavioural guidelines.

When null, part 2 is omitted from the agent prompt.

embeddingConfig.description:
Provider and model configuration used for generating and querying embeddings. Must point to an OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint (e.g. LM Studio `/v1/embeddings`, OpenAI `text-embedding-3-small`).

When null, the RAG index and retrieval services are disabled for this company. Stored as JSONB — same shape as  {@link  LlmConfig }  but the `contextWindow` field is ignored.

id.description: Auto-generated primary key for this company.

llmDefault.description: Optional company-wide default LLM configuration. Roles that do not specify their own  {@link  LcpRole.llmConfig  }  fall back to this value at run time, then to the environment-configured LLM fallback (`LLM_PROVIDER` / `LLM_MODEL`), before failing.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the company.

runConfig.description: Optional company-wide agent-loop resource overrides. Applied when the running role has no  {@link  LcpRole.runConfig  }  set. See  {@link  AgentRunConfig }  for available fields.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier used in API paths and agent namespacing. Must be globally unique across all companies.

LcpRole.description: A role template that defines the behaviour and LLM configuration for an agent. Multiple  {@link  LcpAgent  }  instances can run from the same role within a company.

company.description: The company this role belongs to.

companyId.description: Foreign key column for the owning  {@link  LcpCompany } .

description.description: Human-readable description of what this role does and what outputs it is expected to produce.

id.description: Auto-generated primary key for this role.

knowledgeDomains.description: Knowledge domain tags that will be used for RAG retrieval once the memory system is built. Stored now so roles can be defined ahead of the RAG implementation. ponytail: unused for MVP; consumed by the RAG phase

llmConfig.description: LLM provider and model configuration for agents running in this role. Stored as JSONB. When absent, the agent loop falls back to  {@link  LcpCompany.llmDefault } .

mcpServerList.description: List of MCP server identifiers this role is permitted to call. Stored now; wired to the agent loop once MCP servers are implemented. ponytail: unused for MVP; consumed by the MCP integration phase

name.description: Short identifier for this role within the company (e.g. `'analyst'`, `'planner'`).

queryIndex.description: Monotonically incrementing counter used to generate unique  {@link  Conversation  }  slugs. Incremented atomically (raw SQL `UPDATE … RETURNING`) on each new conversation.

rolePrompt.description:
Optional role prompt injected as prompt part 1 immediately after the system prompt. Covers role identity, attitude, domain knowledge, and behavioural guidelines that are distinct from the system-level instructions.

When null, part 1 is omitted —  {@link  systemPromptTemplate }  continues to serve as the sole pre-task context until a role prompt is explicitly set.

runConfig.description: Optional agent-loop resource overrides for agents running in this role. Takes precedence over  {@link  LcpCompany.runConfig }  and environment variables. See  {@link  AgentRunConfig }  for available fields.

systemPromptTemplate.description: Handlebars-style prompt template injected as the system message at agent start. Available variables: `{{name}}`, `{{description}}`, `{{date}}`, `{{companyId}}`, `{{roleId}}`. The latter two let the agent supply identifiers required by company- and role-scoped MCP tool calls.

LlmConfig.description: Configuration for a specific LLM provider and model. The API key is stored directly in this config object and persisted in the database. Ensure the database has encryption at rest to protect stored keys.

apiKey.description: API key for this provider. Stored in the database as part of the JSONB config block. Masked in API responses when `LCP_MASK_API_KEYS=true` (the default).

baseUrl.description: Base URL override for providers that are not hosted at their default endpoint. Required for `'lm-studio'` (e.g. `'http://localhost:1234/v1'`).

contextWindow.description: Maximum context window for this model in tokens. Used by  {@link  ContextBudgetService  }  to determine when compaction is needed. Defaults to  {@link  DEFAULT_LLM_CONTEXT_WINDOW  }  when absent.

model.description: The model identifier as expected by the provider API (e.g. `'gpt-4o'`, `'qwen3-5b'`).

provider.description: Identifies the provider. Known values: `'lm-studio'` (local OpenAI-compatible endpoint), `'openai'`. Any string value is accepted to support future providers.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for LLM API calls. Defaults to  {@link  DEFAULT_LLM_TIMEOUT_MS  }  when absent. Set higher for slow local models.

MemberType.description: Membership tier for a  {@link  CompanyUser }  within a company.

PendingConsultation.description:
Tracks a paused agent waiting for another agent's consultation response.

Created when an agent calls `request_agent_consultation` via the interactions MCP server. The calling agent is set to  {@link  AgentStatus.Paused  }  until the consultation agent completes and `PauseAndResumeService.completeAgent()` finds this record and re-enqueues the calling agent.

callingAgentId.description: The agent that is paused awaiting the consultation result.

consultationAgentId.description: The newly created agent that will perform the consultation.

result.description: The consultation result written by the consulting agent on completion. Null until the consultation is complete.

VersionedEntity.description:
Abstract base for entities that require optimistic concurrency control.

TypeORM increments `version` on every `save()` and throws `OptimisticLockVersionMismatchError` when a stale version is detected, preventing lost updates under concurrent writes. Callers should wrap writes in  {@link  withOptimisticRetry  } .

Apply to entities with concurrent write patterns: multiple BullMQ workers, HTTP endpoints, or background tasks that can race on the same row.
